CustomField.description: Drives visibility of Digital BU-specific qualification fields. Do not expose on page layout. Internal use only.
CustomField.formula:
OR(ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Digital Solutions'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Information Governance'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Insight'),
ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Product_Line__c, 'Digital Solutions'),
ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Product_Line__c, 'Information Governance'), ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Product_Line__c, 'Insight'))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Returns true when Primary Product Line or Primary Product Line 2 = Digital Solutions, Information Governance, or Insight. Used for Dynamic Forms visibility only.
CustomField.label: Is Digital Primary Product Line
